title: Orientation attendance notice
passage: Staff who attended the weekend orientation should check the attendance list by Tuesday. The list confirms completion of the training; it does not record hours worked. For those hours, use the normal timesheet. If you joined the morning session in person and finished the afternoon session online, make sure the list shows both sessions. Some online entries are still missing. Please send your confirmation email to the training desk if that is the case. Do not add the missing session again in the registration system. The desk can match your email to the original booking.
passageZh: 參加週末入職訓練的員工請最晚於週二查看出席名單。名單只用來確認完成訓練，不會記錄工時。工時要用一般工時表填報。如果你早上到場、下午在線上完成，請確認名單列出兩個時段。目前有些線上紀錄還不在名單上。如果是這個情況，請將確認郵件寄給訓練櫃檯。不要在報名系統裡重新加選缺漏的時段。櫃檯可以把你的郵件與原報名資料配對。
